name: alert_similar
label: Alert Similar Table
description: Analogous table for alerts, belonging to the alert module, is a data table used for related queries and report queries related to alerts.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: alert_id
fields.description: Alert ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: time
fields.description: Alert time. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_alert_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the alert_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_time
indexes.description: Standard index covering the time field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
